prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE reusable illustrated SPADE suit pip for Design 2 playing cards, a prototype master for the ace and for uniformly downscaled numeral-card pips. The two supplied images are STYLE references only: Design 2's approved black lotus-floral back and its blank gold lotus-vine front frame. Do not reproduce a card or frame.
Single unmistakable upright spade silhouette: sharp top point, two full rounded lower lobes, clean inward shoulders and a short flared stem. Bilaterally balanced silhouette with smooth clean contours, entirely visible, centered on a square 1024x1024 canvas with generous transparent padding. Actual transparent alpha outside the silhouette, no white rectangle or painted checkerboard.
Lamp Black #21211F body with a crisp double antique-gold outline and subtle gold beading. Inside the spade, use the back's richly painted Ming/Tang-inspired silk lotus vocabulary: one dominant ivory-and-madder-red lotus rosette, restrained paired teal/verdigris leaves and curling antique-gold stems, small red lotus buds. The central rosette has ONE small round turquoise jewel with a gold rim, placed at the exact canvas center as a future registration anchor. Build the entire upright spade around that anchor. Elegant flat ornamental illustration, crisp print detail, restrained shading; no 3D bevel or photographic lighting. Preserve broad black negative spaces between ornaments and strong silhouette recognition when reduced to approximately 100 pixels tall; do not fill every gap with microdetail. Decoration stays wholly inside the gold outline, including the stem. It should feel native to the provided Design 2 artwork, not Western acanthus or holly.
Only one spade, no other suits, no card, no text, no A, no numerals, no border around the canvas, no external flowers, no ground, no shadow, no watermark. The master will be reused without regenerating its illustration.
